question_record.context: A security incident involving a possible compromised user account was reported, where the account was observed dropping ransomware-related files (`get-userprttoken.ps1`, `characterical.zip`, and `characterical.zip.lockbit`) on several devices. This suggests that an attacker may have compromised the user account to infect many devices with ransomware. The compromised account has the following details: Name: `dp5hn`, AadUserId: `731adb71-b11c-4bbf-850b-57989b350e96`, Sid: `S-1-5-21-1840191660-8534830288-125585561-1522`, IP Address: `99.83.111.100`. Automated remediation actions may have been taken to disable the account.
question_record.question: Following the compromise, there was a possible lateral movement observed. Can you identify the IP address involved in the lateral movement attempt?
solution: A user account was observed dropping a ransomware-related file on the host `vnevado-win11t`.
Lateral movement was observed from the IP address `83.162.58.168` in close time proximity to a suspicious network event.

93.name: Possible compromised user account delivering ransomware-related files
93.description: A user account was observed dropping a ransomware-related file on several devices. An attacker may have compromised the said user account to move laterally across the network and infect as many devices with ransomware as possible. Automated remediation action may be taken to disable the account.

103.name: Possible lateral movement
103.description: Lateral movement on another device was observed in close time proximity to a suspicious network event on this device. This could mean that an attacker is attempting to move laterally across devices to gather data or elevate privileges. This alert was triggered based on a Microsoft Defender for Endpoint alert.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID' AND o.Concept = 'Host_Name'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
parameters: Possible compromised user account delivering ransomware-related files
